-----------------------------------------------------------------------

DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE

National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency

32 CFR Part 320

[NIMA Instruction 5500.7R1]


Privacy Act; Implementation

AGENCY: National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, DoD.

ACTION: Final rule.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The document is published to make administrative changes to 
the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA), formerly know as the 
National Imagery and Mapping Agency, Privacy Program rule.

EFFECTIVE DATE: This rule is effective January 14, 2004.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Ms. M. Flattery, (301) 227-2268.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

List of Subjects in 32 CFR Part 320

    Privacy program.


0
Accordingly, 32 CFR part 320 is amended as follows:

PART 320--NATIONAL GEOSPATIAL-INTELLIGENCE AGENCY (NGA) PRIVACY

Program

0
1. The authority citation for part 320 continues to read as follows:


    Authority: Pub. L. 93-579, 88 Stat. 1986 (5 U.S.C. 552a).


0
2. The part heading is revised as set forth above.


Sec.  320.1  [Amended]

0
3. Section 320.1, paragraph (a)(1)(i) is amended by revising ``National 
Imagery and Mapping Agency (NIMA)'' to read ``National Geospatial-
Intelligence Agency (NGA)''

0
4. The following paragraphs are amended by revising ``NIMA'' to read 
``NGA'': Sec.  320.1 paragraph (a)(2); Sec.  320.2 paragraphs (a), (c), 
(f), (h), and (i); Sec.  320.3 paragraphs (a), (a)(1), (a)(2), (a)(4), 
(b)(6), and (c)(4); Sec.  320.4 paragraphs (a), (b), (c), (c)(2), (d), 
and (e); Sec.  320.5 paragraphs (a), (b), (b)(1), (b)(2), (b)(3), (c), 
(c)(1), (c)(2), and (d)(1); Sec.  320.6 (b); Sec.  320.7 paragraphs (a) 
and (b); Sec.  320.8, paragraphs (b), (c), and (c)(1); Sec.  320.9 
paragraphs (a), (c)(5), and (c)(7); Sec. Sec.  320.10 and 320.11; and 
Sec.  320.12 paragraphs (a), (b)(3)(i), (b)(3)(v) and (b)(3)(vi).

    Dated: January 7, 2004.
L.M. Bynum,
Alternate OSD Federal Register Liaison Officer, Department of Defense.
[FR Doc. 04-758 Filed 1-13-04; 8:45 am]
BILLING CODE 5001-06-P
